name: wh-frontier-task-suite
description: Orchestrate multi-agent creation, independent review, repair, and release of Frontier-Bench submissions.

interface.shortDescription: Run a multi-agent Frontier-Bench task pipeline.
interface.longDescription: A coordinated Codex workflow that spawns isolated author, reviewer, repair, re-review, and release agents to create three original Frontier-Bench tasks and carry them through evidence-backed quality gates without manual task switching.
defaultPrompt: Run the complete multi-agent Frontier-Bench pipeline from authoring through release.
Create three original Frontier-Bench tasks from one supported reference.
Independently audit a three-task Frontier-Bench submission.
Repair all actionable findings from an independent review report.
